decision.quote: Although we replicate previous null findings for attachment style and one of the most widely studied SNPs, OXTR rs53576 (Gillath et al. 2008 ; Rodrigues et al. 2009 ), this corroborative result for rs237897 illustrates the importance of parallel testing of a number of different SNPs for each gene, rather than focusing on a few popular ones.
decision.location: Current Discussion specific rs53576null comparison; complete2017Methods/Results and current published Tables2/S2/S3
decision.reason: Current2018really tests rs53576attachment in newly reported nonwhite and subclinical observations, as positively verified in recovered S2/S3 numerical summary tables; this is not dismissed as merely reused2017data, a blank table or a posthoc citation. The new nonwhite anxiety/avoidance models are nonsignificant, while subclinical additive anxiety is associated(p=.039); no universal current null or outcome is assigned. However the newly recovered complete Pearce2017body and2018comparison matrix establish the intervening empirical friendship-attachment testing program: rs53576is retained, all retained diploid SNPs receive attachment models, the primary reports the attachment findings including no significant avoidant associations, and the matrix distinguishes rs53576nonsignificance from failed models. Exact original2017SIcoefficients/endpointNsremain unavailable, not invented. Existing2469is this2017paper, the current expressly closest operational comparator with the same friendship measure and previously published healthy-white757sample. The older Gillathstandard-ECRnull was already explicitly re-tested by Rodrigues2009; current cited romantic-to-friendship correspondence was in turn empirically tested in2017. The current2018new-group tests therefore revisit a closest previously tested association already represented by2469, not two additional older original targets. This is a positive documented same-endpoint empirical chain, not a claim based on titles/DOIs, absence of old bodies, changed measures alone, or requiring every coefficient to be significant. Preserve explicit co-citation of both older nulls as contrary counting evidence; neither supplies a distinct current re-tested component beyond this chain.
